name: static_fa
description: Frozen config of the static false-alarm measurement (paper: 'we measure the actual rate'): label-free history-conditioned threshold at q = 0.999, persistence k = 2, re-admission with a 5 cm observed-depth tolerance; the residual baselines (NCC, feature, depth) run on the same views with the same label-free rule (pooled q-quantile of their own mapping-pass scores).

data.note: mapping arguments as scripts/replica_tab1.sh (the Table I fields); Sequence_2 shows the same static scene from another trajectory, so every fire of the update pass is a false alarm

fixed_rule: the q-quantile (q = 0.999; upper edge of the q bin of 4000 bins on [0, 2]) of the per-view scores of the tested Gaussians in the update passes of static_fa on the validation scenes, pooled (scripts/static_fa_report.py select): the threshold whose per-view false-alarm rate on the static validation scenes is 1 - q

criterion.text: PRE-REGISTERED (2026-10-10, before any static false-alarm run): the realised per-view false-alarm rate (update-pass fires / defined tests) of this frozen config at q = 0.999 lies within [0.5x, 2x] of the nominal 1e-3, i.e. in [5e-4, 2e-3], on >= 5 of the 6 Replica test scenes. Otherwise the label-free threshold does not deliver its nominal rate, and the paper reports the measured rate instead of the nominal one.
